profile.summary: Valiente Resources is a Lundin Group copper-gold exploration company spun out of NGEx Minerals on 12 November 2026. It holds the 100%-owned Valle Ancho project, which straddles the Argentina-Chile border with the Argentine claims in Catamarca Province, and plans to add copper, gold and silver exploration assets in Argentina and Chile through selective acquisitions. Head office is in Vancouver, shared with NGEx Minerals.
